abstract: A massive teratoma in the faciocervical region was found in a fetus at 21 weeks, with laboratory evidence of anemia and thrombocytopenia. Vaginal delivery was achieved by cardiocentesis followed by Laminaria tent insertion, dilation and evacuation.
abstract_ja: 妊娠21週の胎児に大型の顔頸部奇形腫が認められ、検査所見で貧血と血小板減少が示された。心穿刺の後、ラミナリア挿入、拡張および掻爬を行い、経膣分娩を達成した。
